name: Checkbox
description: A checkbox with a label and optional description, built on the native input.

props.name: label
props.description: Clickable label next to the box.

props.name: ...props
props.description: All native attributes of the underlying element.

a11y: Uses a native checkbox, so Space toggles it and its state is announced.
The whole label toggles the box; the description is linked with aria-describedby.
Checked state is shown by a check mark, not color alone.
